Quarry

A keyboard-first PostgreSQL client for macOS. Connections tagged prod stay read-only until you unlock them.

Loading latest release…

Apple Silicon · macOS

First open

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Quarry.app

The build is unsigned, so macOS quarantines it and refuses the first open until that flag is cleared. Drag Quarry to Applications first.

Linux and Windows — beta

    Never run on a real machine. They build in CI and that is all that is known about them — saved passwords in particular may not work.
